The bookmark app is **built, tested, and ready for your review.**

**Open it at http://maker:4000** and sign in with:
- **Email:** `review@example.com`
- **Password:** `review-access`

(That review account comes preloaded with a few sample bookmarks — including one in "To read", one with a note, one with a saved copy, and one archived — so there's something to explore. You can also create your own account from the same screen.)

**Verification report (plain language):** I checked the software against everything we agreed, and all automated checks pass (14/14), plus a full click-through of the main flows:

- **Saving** — paste a link (even without `https://`), review the auto-fetched title/description/icon/preview, correct them, save; re-saving the same link opens the existing one instead of duplicating.
- **Finding** — instant search across title, description, address, and notes, with quotes, `AND`/`OR`/`NOT`, grouping, and `#tag`.
- **Read-later** — opt-in queue with All / To read / Read filters; opening a link never marks it read.
- **Organising** — tags with suggestions, click-to-filter.
- **Managing** — reversible Archive and confirmed Delete; Markdown notes with a read-only view; bulk actions (incl. add/remove tag, select-all across the filtered set); saved views with include/exclude tag pickers; on-demand page copies (the PDF itself when the file really is a PDF, judged by its actual type), an optional Internet Archive link; JSON + browser-HTML import/export that merges and skips duplicates.
- **Comfort & sync** — remembered sort, page size, and text size; and because it's account-based with central storage, your bookmarks and settings follow you across devices.

Honest notes: the live page/PDF fetching and Internet Archive submission use the real network at save time and fall back gracefully if a site is unreachable; page copies store extracted readable text.

One request you raised — an explicit **"refresh page details"** action when you repoint a bookmark to a different page — I've **recorded for a later cycle** (the current app keeps your own title/description when you edit an address, as we agreed).

**Do you accept this software as meeting the behaviour we approved, completing this cycle?** If anything doesn't behave as an approved scenario says it should, tell me and I'll treat it as a fix within this cycle.
